javadoc_corrections.title: App.execute no longer promises to preserve the calling JVM
javadoc_corrections.old_claim: Executes a CLI invocation without terminating the calling JVM.
javadoc_corrections.correction: Public execute returns an exit status only if selected command execution returns; command failure/stop paths can invoke System.exit. Launcher, package and overview direct embedding applications to Tracer or BatchTracer.

javadoc_corrections.residual_action: Retain corrected Javadoc. Do not merge into F4-2 or silently add to the existing135 audit inventory.
